2609.16748.title: TIAO: Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization for Text Summarization
2609.16748.paper_summary: Text summarization requires models to condense content while preserving key qualities such as consistency and coherence. Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on this task and can be further improved through reinforcement learning (RL). However, most existing methods apply reward signals directly to undifferentiated token sequences, overlooking the varying importance of individual tokens to word and sentence level quality in summarization. In this paper, we propose Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization (TIAO), a novel reinforcement learning strategy that explicitly leverages token-importance awareness. Specifically, TIAO identifies core tokens based on token dependency and reweights a trajectory's advantage according to its overall dependencies. Experiments on the real world dataset show that our TIAO achieves highly competitive results, and that a 7B foundation model enhanced by TIAO performs comparably to GPT-4 and GPT-5-nano. Code is available at https://github.com/TechCloud-x/TIAO
2609.16748.paper_summary_zh: 文本摘要要求模型在保留一致性和連貫性等關鍵特徵的同時，壓縮內容。大型語言模型（LLMs）在這項任務上表現出色，並且可以通過強化學習（RL）進一步改善。然而，大多數現有方法將獎勵信號直接應用於未經區分的標記序列，忽略了單個標記對摘要中單詞和句子層級質量的重要性差異。在本文中，我們提出了標記重要性感知政策優化（TIAO），這是一種新穎的強化學習策略，明確利用標記重要性意識。具體而言，TIAO 根據標記依賴性識別核心標記，並根據其整體依賴性重新加權軌跡的優勢。對現實世界數據集的實驗表明，我們的 TIAO 實現了高度競爭的結果，並且由 TIAO 增強的 7B 基礎模型在性能上與 GPT-4 和 GPT-5-nano 相當。代碼可在 https://github.com/TechCloud-x/TIAO 獲得。
